name: annotasi-finance
description: Technical foundation for the Annotasi Finance Private Beta.

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs scripts && turbo run lint
scripts.db:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/local/.env -f infra/local/compose.yml logs -f postgres
scripts.ci:foundation: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm boundaries && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:api
scripts.iam:test: pnpm --filter @annotasi/api exec vitest run test/token.test.ts test/cookie.test.ts test/session.service.test.ts test/guards.test.ts test/pagination.test.ts && pnpm --filter @annotasi/config exec vitest run test/identity-session-config.test.ts
scripts.ci:iam: pnpm iam:prepare && pnpm iam:test && pnpm iam:test:integration && pnpm iam:test:security && pnpm iam:test:web
scripts.iam2:test:web: pnpm --filter @annotasi/web exec vitest run test/onboarding-interaction.test.tsx test/api-client.test.ts
scripts.ci:iam2: pnpm iam:prepare && pnpm iam2:test && pnpm iam2:test:integration && pnpm iam2:test:http && pnpm iam2:test:web
scripts.account:test: pnpm --filter @annotasi/contracts exec vitest run test/account.test.ts && pnpm --filter @annotasi/api exec vitest run test/account.service.test.ts
scripts.ci:acc1: pnpm iam:prepare && pnpm account:test && pnpm account:test:integration && pnpm account:test:security && pnpm account:test:web
scripts.ci: pnpm ci:foundation && pnpm ci:database && pnpm ci:iam && pnpm ci:iam2 && pnpm ci:acc1
